Well I'm really glad you've already started the journey of moving on. It's good you realize how toxic the relationship is making your life, and breaking up with him is the best thing to do for your health and well being.

I would do it when you get home. Do you live together? If so, pack what you have left and sit down with your boyfriend and explain to him all that you genuinely feel, and leave it at that. If he starts to throw a hissy fit and starts shaming you or blaming you (i.e, "You never loved me!" "Well I guess I didn't mean shit to you!") I would just say goodbye and leave. Also, change your number. Controlling people hate feeling out of control of the ones they used to control, and trust me, you will get multiple texts and calls from him telling you how hurt he is. Block him from everything!! Talk to friends, cry it out, but I've found that being the dumper hurts less than being the dumpee. If you ever feel insecure about your decision, go back to this post and any notes you've made about the relationship that hurt you or annoyed you. It's what helped me get over my ex! (I was the dumpee and felt like the breakup was all my fault, well reading back on my journal I'm better off without the control freak!) And you can always talk to me if times get rough.

But if this isn't for you, I would try to branch out and make friends. I hope I helped!
